items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: That was a lot of people who would say they were the king, you know, King Oliver and King Caput.

ctx.x: I forget the man. The man. Yeah. The trumpet player in Olympia was? Who did you say the trumpet player in Olympia was?

Who did you say the trumpet player in Olympia was? Where did you live? On Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Oakland Who did you say the trombone player in Olympia was? The trombone player in Olympia was, I forget the name, I don't know. August. Where does he live? On Clairvon Street. Between the new man and St. Paul, I believe. You know where Hank Robinson lived around there? His name is Robinson, I think. Big Ike is a boy. Ike Robinson. Big Ike is the one I…
Well, there aren't many clarinet players called Kit, are they? That's mostly trumpet players. No, no clarinet players. No.

items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Or Joe Oliver? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, for dancing I really did like Sam Morgan for dance music.

ctx.x: Or Joe Oliver? Anita. What would be the best of the old time bands that you ever heard that you can remember? If you had to pick one band either that you played with or that you didn't play with that you used to hear at dances. What would be the best band that you can think of that you've heard?
Well, for dancing I really did like Sam Morgan for dance music.
